title: 检查时间不是修复时间
premise: 证据表明异常时段相关，但尚未定位故障点；交代供应商进展。
listeningTask: 听清供应商受理、检查时点与修复ETA的区别。

lines.en: Okay, carrier ticket C-four-eighty-two remains open. They acknowledged the evidence at seven thirty.
lines.zh: 好，运营商工单C-482仍开放。他们七点半确认收到证据。

lines.en: What's the ETA for a repair? Did they commit to a restoration time?
lines.zh: 修复预计多久？他们承诺恢复时间了吗？

lines.en: No restoration estimate, only a diagnostic update. That's due at nine this evening.
lines.zh: 没有恢复时间估计，只承诺今晚九点给诊断更新。

lines.en: Which checks have they completed already? An acknowledgment isn't evidence of technical progress.
lines.zh: 他们已经完成了什么检查？受理确认不代表技术进展。

lines.en: They report clean optics at their local handoff. Remote segment counters are still pending.
lines.zh: 他们报告本地交接端光指标正常，远端链路计数器还未提供。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the root cause is still open, right? We haven't verified their remote segment.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，根因仍未定，对吧？还没核实他们的远端链路。

lines.en: Please record that wording in the ticket. Who owns the carrier escalation path?
lines.zh: 把这个措辞写进工单。谁负责运营商升级路径？

lines.en: Raj owns it until this handoff closes. Then Hannah takes the carrier follow-up.
lines.zh: 交接完成前由Raj负责，之后Hannah跟进运营商。

lines.en: Accepted, with ticket access verified first. I'll request the missing remote counter evidence.
lines.zh: 接受，但要先确认工单访问权限。我会索取缺失的远端计数器证据。

lines.en: Compensation discussion? Let's park that for later. So, technical follow-up continues around nine.
lines.zh: 赔偿讨论先留到以后。技术跟进继续在九点左右进行。
